newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Explosion wrecks home of Albanian judge.
newsitem.headline: Explosion wrecks home of Albanian judge.

text.p: An explosion wrecked the apartment of a senior Albanian appeals court judge early on Wednesday, injuring four people including his seven-year-old daughter, police said.

The fourth and fifth floor of the building in central Tirana where judge Prel Martini lived with his family suffered widespread damage. Police said they did not yet know what kind of device caused the explosion.

Martini received slight injuries and his daughter Dea was treated in hospital for injuries to a leg. Two women in adjoining apartments were also wounded but were released from hospital after treatment.

"All the outer walls in the fourth and fifth floors of the building were destroyed with bricks covering the people. But they were lucky, God saved them," an Interior Ministry spokesman told reporters.
Four people were killed and 27 injured last February when a car bomb exploded in central Tirana just 200 metres (yards) from Martini's apartment.
Police later arrested members of what they called a guerrilla organisation comprising former communist secret policemen and charged them with planting the bomb.
